title: Finite étale Artinian lift of a separable residue element
statement: Let $D$ and $S$ be commutative local Artinian rings (each has a unique maximal ideal and every descending chain of ideals stabilizes), and let $g:D\to S$ be a flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] local homomorphism. It induces an embedding of residue fields $F=D/\mathfrak m_D\to K=S/\mathfrak m_S$ [def-weil-residue-field]. For every $b\in K$ separable over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], there are a commutative local Artinian $D$-algebra $D_1$ and a local homomorphism $g_1:D_1\to S$ such that $D_1$ is finite as a $D$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and étale over $D$ (its affine spectrum map is étale [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-etale-morphism]), $D\to D_1$ is local, $g_1$ is flat, $g_1\circ(D\to D_1)=g$, and there is $d\in D_1$ with $\operatorname{res}_S(g_1(d))=b$. If $D:\mathrm{Type}(u)$ and $S:\mathrm{Type}(v)$, one may take $D_1:\mathrm{Type}(\max(u,v,z))$ for any ambient universe $z$. This asserts only capture in the residue field, not capture of a specified lift in $S$.

proof.text: Let $F=D/\mathfrak m_D$, $K=S/\mathfrak m_S$ and $E=F(b)\subseteq K$. Since $b$ is separable over $F$, the simple extension $E/F$ is finite separable and therefore finite étale.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Artinian local rings $D$ and $S$ are Noetherian with nilpotent maximal ideals and only one prime, hence are henselian. Apply the essential-surjectivity clause of the finite étale equivalence for $D$ to $E$. It gives a finite étale $D$-algebra $D_1$ with $D_1/\mathfrak m_DD_1\cong E$. The ideal $\mathfrak m_DD_1$ is nilpotent and the quotient is a field, so the elements outside it are units; $D_1$ is local and $D\to D_1$ is local. Finiteness makes $D_1$ Noetherian, and the nilpotent maximal ideal makes it Artinian.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Form the étale $S$-algebra $B=S\otimes_D D_1$. Its reduction maps onto $K$ using $E\hookrightarrow K$ and the residue map $S\to K$; the kernel $Q$ is prime over $\mathfrak m_S$ and its residue field is $K$. Henselian étale retraction supplies $B\to S$ reducing to this map. Restriction to $D_1$ gives a map $g_1:D_1\to S$ factoring $D\to S$. It is local because $D_1$ has only one prime; it induces the specified embedding $E\to K$. Lift $b\in E$ through the quotient map of $D_1$ to an element $d$, so $\operatorname{res}_S(g_1(d))=b$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Tag 07FI (lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo), lines 2642–2675

proof.text: Apply the Noetherian fibre flatness criterion to $D\to D_1\to S$ and $M=S$. The maps are local, $M$ is finite and nonzero over $S$, and is flat over $D$ by hypothesis. Its fibre is a module over $D_1/\mathfrak m_DD_1=E$, a field, hence flat. Thus $g_1$ is flat. Replace $D_1$ by its canonical universe lift if necessary, transporting the ring, algebra, maps and properties through the ring equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_artinian_residue_lift
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    [Algebra D S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap D S)]
    (hflat : (algebraMap D S).Flat) (b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
    (hb : IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D) b) :
    ∃ (D' : Type (max u v z)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : Algebra D D') (g' : D' →+* S),
      IsLocalRing D' ∧ IsArtinianRing D' ∧
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap D D') ∧ IsLocalHom g' ∧
      Etale D D' ∧ Module.Finite D D' ∧ g'.Flat ∧
      g'.comp (algebraMap D D') = algebraMap D S ∧
      ∃ d : D', IsLocalRing.residue S (g' d) = b
